scores.label: A
scores.note: options 1-5, 9 and 10 are -ing forms ('if they persisting/striving/advocating/laboring/pushing/pressing/continuing'), ungrammatical in place; best option buried at 6; 6-8 duplicate 1-3 in base form

scores.label: B
scores.note: maintain, adhere, pursue and champion need an object or preposition so are ungrammatical in place ('if they maintain/adhere/pursue/champion'); defend is wrong meaning and also transitive

scores.label: C
scores.note: maintain, urge and encourage need an object and do not mean persisting ('if they maintain/urge/encourage'), so wrong in place
